blocks.text: Is unit ne model building aur data visualization batayi: asal masail hal karne mein statistical models ka kirdar, linear regression jaise bunyadi models banana aur jaanchna, experimental design, visualizations ki qismein aur istemal, descriptive statistics, aur MS Excel, Google Sheets, Python (Matplotlib) aur Tableau jaise tools. Khulasa hypothesis testing, randomization aur heatmaps ka bhi zikr karta hai, jinhein chapter naam leta hai magar tafseel se nahi sikhata.
